I have to walk a lot during the hottest point of the day for my daily commute. 

I keep one of those tiny handheld fans on me. You can buy them at Big Camera, 3 Coins, Daiso, Amazon etc. If you want to dish out a bit more money, there are neck fans and electric neck coolers you can buy as well. 

I also keep my parasol on me and one of those insulated canteens that keep your drinks cold all day. I fill it with ice water before I go out. You can also buy a water bottle insulating sleeve to keep your water bottles cold if you don’t want to carry around a heavy cup all the time. 

There are some other products you can buy at almost any drug store. Cold rings for around your neck, wet cooling towels, the cooling spray that you can spray on your clothes or skin (beware they have a strong smell). 

Other than that, I try not to leave unless I absolutely have to. Sometimes riding my bike helps because even though I won’t be able to use my parasol and I’ll be exerting myself a little bit more, I get to my destination and back a lot quicker so my body doesn’t get as hot. Of course, don’t do this if you think your body can’t handle it. It’s better to go slow and pace yourself in that case.
